title: Exploring the impact of siloxane networks on the thermal behavior of P/N-enriched flame-retardant finishes for cotton fabric
treatment_method: Pristine source cotton; no flame-retardant finish
TG_preconditioning: 100 C hold for 5 min to remove adsorbed water; TG-only preconditioning
LOI_method: upper-edge ignition using Fire Testing Technology oxygen index apparatus; no LOI standard number stated
TG_locator: Table 2, final journal p. 6; Section 3.3.1, pp. 5-6
LOI_locator: Section 3.2, final journal p. 5; explicit measured-pristine-cotton LOI 18.6%
conditions_locator: Section 2.1, final journal p. 2; Sections 2.4 and 2.10, p. 4
pairing_evidence: CEJ Section 3.2 reports pristine cotton LOI 18.6% as the measured untreated control in this work. CEJ Table 2 reports the same Cotton control under nitrogen and air. Section 2.1 identifies the 170 g/m2 plain woven cotton substrate and Sections 2.4/2.10 define TG and LOI methods. Selected as the sole canonical control; the related PDS Cotton record is not separately admitted. The nitrogen TG row is shared across papers and is not a new independent experiment.
source_location: Final published article pp. 2, 4-6; Sections 2.1, 2.4, 2.10, 3.2, 3.3.1 and Table 2
limitations: Relevant final-journal source text inspected; no PDF pixel QA. Nitrogen T5 is omitted because Table 2 reports 322 C but Section 3.3.1 reports 324 C. R700 is the reported residue endpoint, distinct from the 750 C scan endpoint. Residues at DTG peaks are stored separately. The 100 C/5 min moisture hold is TG-only preconditioning, not a separate textile or LOI treatment. This is a newly completed canonical pair using shared nitrogen TG, not a new independent experiment. Keep future PO Cotton outside a second state count. No LOI reuse claim is made.
cross_paper_reuse_note: CEJ Table 2 and PDS112025 Table 2 print the identical Cotton nitrogen TG row. CEJ Cotton is the sole canonical control for target counting; prevent a future separate PO Cotton state admission. TG reuse only is established; do not assert LOI reuse. The disputed nitrogen T5 is omitted. Air values are CEJ measurements; cross-paper air TG identity is not asserted.
source_title: Exploring the impact of siloxane networks on the thermal behavior of P/N-enriched flame-retardant finishes for cotton fabric
